approvedConvention: Preserve existing namespace; use stable semantic camelCase suffixes; keep dynamic values as parameters; share only when owner, consumer and parameter contract match.
rationale: The two functions have explicit DOM consumers. Complete UI messages and labels are proposed with dynamic values parameterized. Fragment-only and content-owned strings are held back rather than assigned unstable keys.
limitations: Proposal only; no source or canonical index changes.
Current concatenation means dynamic message template extraction would require a product-code migration.
Plural and list formatters are not part of this audit.
The static HTML pair needs two message boundaries.
